tool.name: OGS: AssignRasterDataToMesh
tool.description: Assigns the pixel information of a raster file to a scalar array of a specified 2D mesh.
tool.command: ln -sf '$raster' 'raster.asc'; ln -sf '$input' 'input.vtu'; AssignRasterDataToMesh #if str($nodata) --nodata '$nodata' #end if $cell_array $node_array --scalar-name '$scalar_name' --raster 'raster.asc' --input 'input.vtu' --output output_1.vtu

param.label: nodata
param.help: The no data value used for missing values

param.label: cell array
param.help: Assigns raster data to cell array

param.label: node array
param.help: Assigns raster data to node array (default)

param.label: scalar name
param.help: The name of the newly created scalar array.

param.label: raster
param.help: Input (.asc). Name of the input raster file

param.label: input
param.help: Input (.vtu). Name of the input mesh file

tool.help: Assigns the pixel information of a raster file to a scalar array of a specified 2D mesh. Data will be assigned to a node array by default. Adding information to cell arrays is also possible, pixel values at the centre of the cell will be used in this case. Note that large differences in resolution between cell size of the mesh and pixel size of the raster can give unexpected results. A no-data value will be added in case of missing or transparent values.
